note: Known AI platforms with the evidence that reveals them on a machine and the route to connect each one. Adding a platform is a change to this file. Routes with verified=false are written from vendor documentation and have not been exercised through AI Hub yet; the card says so. Values of keys are never read by the scanner; only variable names.

routes.guidance: Open beta. Sign in with your Dropbox account. If Dropbox refuses the sign-in from AI Hub, it needs an app created in the Dropbox App Console first.

platforms.name: Google Drive MCP server
platforms.description: Google's remote Drive server: search, read, metadata, create and download. A Google Drive folder synced to this PC also works as a project folder without any connection.

routes.label: Sign in with your own Google sign-in app
routes.guidance: Google only accepts a sign-in app from your own Google Cloud project, and its Drive server needs the Workspace Developer Preview Program. Create an OAuth client there with the callback address AI Hub shows, then press Sign in and enter its client ID when AI Hub asks.

platforms.name: OneDrive and SharePoint MCP server
platforms.description: Microsoft's remote server for OneDrive and SharePoint files (work or school accounts). A OneDrive folder synced to this PC also works as a project folder without any connection.

routes.label: Enter your tenant's server address
routes.guidance: The address is https://agent365.svc.cloud.microsoft/agents/tenants/<tenant id>/servers/mcp_ODSPRemoteServer with your Microsoft Entra tenant id. Needs Microsoft Agent 365 with a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence, enabled by your admin. Personal OneDrive accounts are not covered by Microsoft's documentation.
